$comment: The Claude Code hooks modules can bring; each goes to .claude/hooks/<name>. Each entry says where it comes from: `install` (a command; it runs when a path in `output` is missing, and those paths go when no module needs the entry any more), `copy` (a file or folder in library/, copied whole) or `template` (a file in template/, which Copier renders and merges with the project's edits). An entry with none of these is written by another entry's `install` (listed in its `output`). `frameworks` (if any) lists the frameworks it fits; elsewhere it is left out. apply.mjs writes `event`, `matcher`, `timeout` and `statusMessage` into .claude/settings.json and `describe` into .claude/harness.md ({checks} and {fileChecks} become the project's checks).

session-start.sh.describe: (session start, resume or clear): reports whether dependencies are installed, whether a dev server already runs, and how many files are uncommitted.

guard-commands.sh.describe: (before every Bash command): blocks force push and skipping git hooks (`--no-verify`, `SKIP_VERIFY`).

format-lint-file.sh.describe: (after every edit): {fileChecks} on the edited file.

check-all.sh.describe: (end of every turn): {checks}; skipped when only `.md` files changed or the same code already passed.
